buildings.name: Main Entrance
buildings.aka: Main Gate / Security Post / Guard Desk
buildings.desc: Main security checkpoint, visitor registration desk, and 24/7 campus gate.

buildings.name: Patanjali
buildings.desc: Faculty offices, conference rooms, dean suites, and academic research centres.

buildings.name: Gyanodaya Library
buildings.desc: 24/7 Central Library with Bloomberg terminals, quiet reading zones, and digital archives.

buildings.name: Bake-o-Mocha
buildings.desc: Popular student cafe serving hot beverages, baked goods, and late-night snacks till 3 AM.

buildings.name: Hostel 10
buildings.desc: Student residential hall block 10 with laundry and recreation lounge.

buildings.name: Hostels 13 & 14
buildings.desc: Twin student hostel complex with common study room and courtyard.

buildings.name: Futsal Ground
buildings.desc: Floodlit artificial turf court for futsal, five-a-side football, and evening matches.

buildings.name: Cricket Ground
buildings.desc: Full-size grass cricket oval with stadium pavilions and athletics track.

buildings.name: Aryabhatt Guest House
buildings.aka: MDC / Executive Guest House / VIP Suites
buildings.desc: Management Development Centre (MDC) executive suites and visiting faculty lodge.

buildings.name: Utsav Auditorium
buildings.desc: Grand campus auditorium and open amphitheatre for convocation, cultural fests, and conclaves.

buildings.name: Chintan Bhawan
buildings.aka: Bodhi Griha 3 / BG3 / Academic Block / Hall 5 / Hall 1
buildings.desc: Primary academic building containing lecture halls (Halls 1 to 8), IT centre, and case study rooms.

buildings.name: Samadhan Admin Block
buildings.aka: Admin Tower / Director Office / Admissions / Accounts / Room 108 / G-12
buildings.desc: Central administration block housing Admissions (G-12), Director's Office, and Accounts (Room 108).

buildings.name: Annapoorna Mess
buildings.aka: Central Dining Complex / Mess 1 / Food Court
buildings.desc: Central student and faculty dining hall serving multi-cuisine breakfast, lunch, and dinner.

buildings.name: Samarpan Health Centre
buildings.aka: Medical Centre / Pharmacy / OPD / Doctor Clinic
buildings.desc: 24/7 campus hospital with emergency care, resident physicians, pharmacy, and ambulance.

buildings.name: Anusandhan
buildings.aka: SCIFI Incubation / Research Centre / Innovation Hub
buildings.desc: SCIFI startup incubator, research laboratories, and doctoral research suites.

rooms.name: Hall 5
rooms.directions_text: Enter Chintan (Bodhi Griha 3) via the Main Portico -> Head up the central marble staircase to Floor 1 -> Turn right down the East Wing corridor -> Hall 5 is the 3rd tiered lecture theatre on your left (adjacent to Faculty Lounge).

rooms.name: Hall 1 (Auditorium)
rooms.directions_text: Enter Chintan Bhawan main entrance -> Proceed straight past security desk into the central atrium -> Hall 1 Main Auditorium entrance is directly in front with double mahogany doors.

rooms.name: Admissions Office (G-12)
rooms.directions_text: Enter Samadhan Admin Block through main glass doors -> Turn left past the central reception -> Follow the hallway 20 metres -> Room G-12 (Admissions & PGP Office) is on your right.

rooms.name: Finance & Accounts (Room 108)
rooms.directions_text: Enter Samadhan Admin Block -> Take elevator or stairs to Floor 1 -> Turn left toward the Accounts Cell -> Room 108 is at the end of the north corridor for fee clearance and receipts.

rooms.name: Digital Reference & Bloomberg Terminal
rooms.directions_text: Enter Gyanodaya Central Library through security turnstiles -> Take the staircase on the right to 2nd Floor -> Enter the Digital Reference & Financial Data Lab on the north side.

rooms.name: Doctor Consultation Room 1
rooms.directions_text: Enter Samarpan Health Centre via the accessible ramp -> Reception desk on right -> Consultation Room 1 is through the first door on your left.

rooms.name: SCIFI Startup Lounge
rooms.directions_text: Enter Anusandhan Centre -> Take staircase to Floor 1 -> Turn right into the SCIFI Incubation & Startup Lounge.

rooms.name: Vegetarian Dining Hall
rooms.directions_text: Enter Annapoorna Mess main entrance -> Head right toward the East Wing buffet counters -> Tray return station is near the exit door.

rooms.name: H10 Common Room
rooms.directions_text: Enter Hostel 10 main archway -> Common room and table tennis area is situated immediately to the left of the warden desk.
